description: Cartesian product axis definitions for combinatorial verification of the M5 Orchestrator integration logic. The configuration space is the product of three orthogonal axes representing upstream module classification states. Each configuration is evaluated against a structural assertion set encoding the logical invariants the orchestrator must respect.

states.label: suspicious_trend
states.description: Trend present but borderline or with reliability concerns

states.label: floor_effect
states.description: Global RNFL <= 50 microns; slope analysis unreliable

states.label: myopia_limited_structural_signal
states.description: High myopia with RNFL trend below -1.0 microns/year

states.label: unclassifiable_artifact_or_data
states.description: Implausible RNFL values or scan artifact concern

states.label: unknown
states.description: Either current_iop_mmhg or target range is missing

structural_invariants_per_cell.description: Each of the 192 cells is evaluated against 5 structural assertions (A1-A5)

assertions.A1: integrated_classification is non-empty and is one of the 21 declared outcome family branches
assertions.A2: integrated_risk is one of {low, moderate, high, indeterminate}
assertions.A3: integrated_confidence is one of {high, moderate, low}
assertions.A4: Logical coherence: concordant_progression with above_target produces high risk; floor_effect must not silently downgrade functional progression; insufficient_data must not be forced to a classification
assertions.A5: Confidence respects min(upstream_confidences) plus documented penalty rules

outcome_family_distribution.note: Distribution reflects clinically meaningful integration patterns; concordant patterns cluster, discordance patterns are explicitly differentiated, and signal-limited contexts retain their structural caveats.

pass_criterion.rule: A configuration passes only when ALL 5 structural assertions are satisfied. Partial satisfaction does not count as a pass.
pass_criterion.rationale: Strict pass criterion ensures the orchestrator behavior conforms to specification across the full state space of upstream classification combinations.
